# Copilot instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It is the single source of rules,
commands, the definition of done and the repository map for every coding agent on this project.
Then read [`HANDOFF.md`](../HANDOFF.md) for the current state and next step, and
[`docs/ARGUS-V2-PLAN.md`](../docs/ARGUS-V2-PLAN.md). Update the root handoff's state and session
log before stopping. Keep `.local/` private and never commit it.
